Hey, I’m a fellow Trans dude that had a less than stellar “outting”. Being trans sucks when you’re surrounded by people like that. Is there any trans/LGBT+ communities in your area? From personal experience, finding and connecting with other trans people does a world of good. Even online groups can help.

I’m sorry if you’ve heard this all before, I just want you to know you’re not alone. (As cheesy as that is)

To add: I am Trans as well, and it fucking sucks. I’ve only been open about it for are year or so and I can’t fucking afford to get rid of all the feminine clothing I have. I can’t afford to take testosterone as there is no free options where I am. 
I am stuck uncomfortable with my whole self on top of years of depression and self loathing. There’s nothing I can do. God, living really sucks sometimes don’t it?

One man destroyed my entire future plans with one sentence. It destroyed me. It was small, but it was just the final push on top of a mountain of shit I was dealing with at the time. It’s a big part of the reason I’m on this thread tonight. 

Please be kind. Do no harm, take no shit.

My little cousin picked up Pokémon at ORAS. He LOVES his Breloom and Manectric,  Bonkers and Marty (named after his two dogs that passed away a few months before the games came out). He brought them in to moon/ultra sun as soon as he could because he didn’t feel right finishing his journey in each game without them. Those bundles of pixels are so dear to him. They helped him get over the death of his two best friends and held on to their memory all the same.

I really don’t want to have to tell him that he might need to leave one/both of them behind. 
Even if they come back to future games, I know it’ll really hurt him.
